The [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Grumbog]] once operated a '''[[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]'''. Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the stronghold was assaulted by a team of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agents, consisting of [[Vor'en Kurn]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Deel Surool]], and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]].
